about: I am Muhammad Basim (Roll No. GA-23039), a Computer Science student specialising in Gaming & Animation at NED University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi.

I enjoy building games and interactive graphics. My latest game is a 2D Spider Game in C++ with OpenGL/GLUT, featuring animated spider sprites, collision detection, difficulty levels and sound effects.
I program mainly in C++ and Python, and I am learning 3D modelling in Blender, motion graphics in After Effects, web development and AI tools such as RAG chatbots.

projects.title: Interactive 3D Web Portfolio
projects.description: This website: a 3D portfolio with a custom Blender avatar, an After Effects promo video, a RAG-based AI chatbot that answers questions about me, and a secure contact form.
highlights: Three.js scene with mouse-reactive 3D objects and an animated, rigged avatar
RAG chatbot: chunking, Gemini embeddings, vector search and grounded answers with citations
Contact form with frontend and backend validation, honeypot and rate limiting

projects.title: Spider Game (C++ / OpenGL / GLUT)
projects.description: A 2D arcade shooter built for the CT-384 Graphics Design CCA. A house with a rotating cannon on its roof defends itself against spiders that crawl, bounce off the walls, drop on silk threads and chase the house on higher levels.
highlights: Keyboard and mouse controls: move the house, rotate the cannon and shoot
Multiple animated spider sprites (small, purple and black widow with 3-hit health bar) with moving legs
Movement patterns: bounce, zig-zag, thread-drop and chase, using speed and direction (dx = s·cosθ·t)
Circle collision detection (dist < r1 + r2) for bullets, spiders and the house
Scoring, lives, Easy / Medium / Hard difficulty, level progression and a saved high score
Sound effects, particle explosions, floating score text, screen shake and a night-sky scene with moon and cobwebs

projects.title: SAP AR Aging Report (ZFI_AR_AGING)
projects.description: A custom SAP accounts-receivable aging report (ZFI_AR_AGING) that breaks open customer items into aging buckets by days, reconciled against SAP's standard RFIDCN_AR_AGING report.
highlights: Days-based aging breakdown of open receivables
Results reconciled against the standard SAP aging report
